required: Set up two-factor sign-in to continue.
requiredDetail: Your role needs two-factor authentication. The rest of EmailSquire opens once it is on.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

details.title: Profile
details.name: Name
details.emailHint: You sign in with this address. It can't be changed here.
details.failed: The name could not be saved.

password.title: Password
password.subtitle: Changing it signs you out everywhere else. This browser stays signed in.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
password.failed: The password could not be changed.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.offText: Sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone as well as your password.
twoFactor.onText: Sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.setupText: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type the secret key into it. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.codeHint: Codes work once. If you just used one, wait for the next.
twoFactor.codesLow: You are running out of recovery codes. Regenerate them so you can still sign in if you lose your phone.
twoFactor.offBody: Sign-in will ask for your password only. We'll email you about the change.
twoFactor.offRequired: Your role needs two-factor authentication: the rest of EmailSquire stays closed until you turn it on again.
twoFactor.regenerateBody: Your current recovery codes stop working at once.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.text: Each code signs you in once without your authenticator app. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.text: Still signed in on a computer or phone you no longer use? Sign out there from here. This browser stays signed in.
sessions.confirmBody: Every other browser where you are signed in is signed out. This one stays signed in. We'll email you about it.
sessions.done: Signed out everywhere else. This browser stays signed in.
sessions.failed: The other sessions could not be signed out.
